fusions.name: Ink Burst
fusions.desc: Spews a cone of ink 5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Blunted], lowering the target's critical chance for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Eight-Arm Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out for 8 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Jet Away
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles in a burst. Your movement speed rises 30% for 3s after you use it.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 6%.
